posts.title: TRMNL Solar E-Ink Dashboard Review
posts.description: We spotted this on the e-ink subreddit and immediately ordered one. A custom solar energy dashboard, running for months on a single charge — sold. posts.title: Ikea sliding closed needs a little 3D printed fix
posts.description: My Ikea Pax sliding closet is already over 10 years old now, but it should be no excuse not to do its job anymore. But the height adjustment did not work properly and eventually one of the two doors felt out of the closet onto my TV. posts.title: Starting issues with the Infineon Xensiv Sensor 2Go Kit
posts.description: Starting with a new hardware platform often has its own issues. The same principle applies also to the Infineon Xensiv Sensor 2Go Kit. Here are the issues I have encountered so far: *Wrong silk screen:** One pin is marked as NC, but instead some functionality is connected to the pin. (Page 4 Optiga board, Pin 12). Another issue is the documentation itself, it's also not error free. The Optiga Quic
